title: Even Simpler Shopping
description: This datapack adds a shopping system so you can sell your items for diamonds, in a completely grief-proof way.
body:
# Introduction

Even simpler shopping is a tool used to make shops for SMP's. Anyone can set up a shop and sell their items for diamonds. Using this system will prevent players from being able to steal your stock or diamonds.

## How to use

To set up your shop, stand where you want the shop set up. Hold the item you want to sell and enter ```/trigger ess:sell set <amount>```. Amount in this case is the amount of diamonds you want to sell your item for **not** the amount of the item you want to sell.

To restock your shop, right-click the shop with its item in your hand

To take profits from your shop, left-click your shop

To buy from a shop, have the requisite diamonds in your inventory and left- or right-click the shop

To remove your shop, stand in the shop you want to remove and type  ```/trigger ess:remove_shop```. All your stock will be returned
